name: platform-install
notes: Names only. Never put values here. Read by cloud/health.js (/__core/health, /__core/install/plan) and install/apply.js.

required.name: config
required.why: Public site config JSON (firebase web config, title, colors).

required.name: googleJson
required.why: Firebase service account JSON used by cloud/fire.js.

required.name: origin
required.why: This site's own origin for links and callbacks.

optional.name: pixabayKey
optional.feature: Image search in the image browser (pixel)

optional.name: TZ
optional.feature: Scheduled jobs run in local time

optional.name: gtag
optional.feature: Analytics tag in the page shell

optional.name: sentry
optional.feature: Error reporting in the page shell

optional.name: logrocket
optional.feature: Session replay in the page shell

optional.name: manifest
optional.feature: PWA manifest link in the page shell

optional.name: bodyLimit
optional.feature: Max JSON/form body on cloud routes (default 50mb)

optional.name: uploadLimitMb
optional.feature: Max upload size per file on cloud routes (default 50)

optional.name: frameOptions
optional.feature: Send X-Frame-Options (DENY or SAMEORIGIN); off by default

optional.name: gptKey
optional.feature: OpenAI requests from site handlers (_gpt, administrator ai)

data.why: Site settings: typed values and the site schema (cloud/settings.js), plus subSite and domain.
At least one account with roles (installer becomes root).
Home of site-wide code projects and Comm templates.
At least one live (starred) prod default version.
Site project at its fixed home (doc id = projectId 'site'): site files, client files, cloud handlers; '__<name>' handlers run at boot and are never served.

steps.title: Set required env names on the host app
Make the installer root in roles/{uid} (install/apply.js --root-email)
Install the site project at dev/site (install/apply.js; --site-from for a full export)
Add the Site Code entry to the starred admin page (install/apply.js)
Release install/firestore.rules on a new project (install/apply.js --rules)
Create the manage group if missing
Copy Comm templates from a source site
Install product packages through the code-change process

settings.notes: Non-secret settings: admin/settings values (typed by the core schema plus the site's schema map). Secrets stay in env; no setting is read from env.
